description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 2 Zeal

Duration 1 minute

Your Idol can briefly fight as a genuine combatant in its own right.

Your Idol swells into a fighting shape. For the duration it is a Medium creature with your AC, your saving throws, and Hit Points equal to 8 times your level. It acts on your initiative and takes 2 actions on each of your turns without you spending actions to command it. Its Strikes use your class DC's attack modifier and deal 2d10 + your key ability modifier damage of a type appropriate to your patron. It cannot Cast a Spell. When the duration ends, or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it returns to its usual form and you cannot use this feat again until your next daily preparations.
